name: Light Sand Between Ceiling Finish Coats
intent: Light fine-grit sand of cured first ceiling finish coat to flatten any nibs or laydown imperfections before second coat. Always followed by vacuum dust. QT4 and QT5 only. Sand rate varies by application method because spray-applied film has less laydown texture than rolled film.
doctrine: Roll-applied first coat has visible laydown texture that requires more sanding at QT5 (350 SF/hr) than spray-applied first coat (500 SF/hr at QT5) because the spray film is already smoother. At QT4 the difference disappears — both methods sand at 500 SF/hr because the QT4 inspection threshold doesn't reward extra sanding effort.
